widgets.title: Additions / Deletions by author
widgets.sqlQuery:
SELECT
  authored_at AS date, author_signature || ' (additions)' AS series, CAST(additions AS INTEGER) AS value FROM commits
UNION ALL
SELECT
  authored_at AS date, author_signature || ' (deletions)' AS series, -CAST(deletions AS INTEGER) AS value FROM commits

widgets.title: Commits by Day / Hour
widgets.sqlQuery:
SELECT 
    dayname(authored_at) as x, -- weekdays
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM authored_at) as y, -- hour of day
    COUNT(sha) as value -- number of commits
FROM commits
GROUP BY 1,2, EXTRACT(DOW FROM authored_at)
ORDER BY y, EXTRACT(DOW FROM authored_at);

widgets.title: Issues opened / closed over time
widgets.sqlQuery:
SELECT created_at AS date, author || '(opened)' AS series, 1 AS value FROM github_issues
UNION ALL
SELECT closed_at AS date, author || '(closed)' AS series, -1 AS value FROM github_issues WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL
